trajectory.patch:
Based on the error log, there is a Kconfig warning indicating a conflict between `CONFIG_STACK_SENTINEL` and `CONFIG_USERSPACE`. The test enables `CONFIG_TEST_USERSPACE=y`, which in turn enables `CONFIG_USERSPACE=y`. However, `CONFIG_STACK_SENTINEL` has a dependency on `!USERSPACE`, meaning it cannot be enabled when userspace is active.

The board configuration for `imx95_evk_mimx9596_a55_smp` likely enables `CONFIG_STACK_SENTINEL=y` by default, causing this conflict. The Kconfig system resolves this by forcing `CONFIG_STACK_SENTINEL=n` but issues a warning.

To fix this, we should explicitly disable `CONFIG_STACK_SENTINEL` in the project's configuration file, as it is incompatible with the userspace mode required by this test.

tests/kernel/semaphore/semaphore/prj.conf
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
CONFIG_TEST_USERSPACE=y
========
CONFIG_TEST_USERSPACE=y
CONFIG_STACK_SENTINEL=n
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
trajectory.filtered_log:
[Kconfig/Configuration Error Detected]
warning: STACK_SENTINEL (defined at subsys/debug/Kconfig:125) was assigned the value 'y' but got the
value 'n'. Check these unsatisfied dependencies: (!USERSPACE) (=n). See
http://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/kconfig.html#CONFIG_STACK_SENTINEL and/or look up
STACK_SENTINEL in the menuconfig/guiconfig interface. The Application Development Primer, Setting
Configuration Values, and Kconfig - Tips and Best Practices sections of the manual might be helpful
too.
